loops.name: research-ingest-monitor
loops.pitch: Want a loop that watches for .system/research.md in this topic and ingests completed research back into the wiki?
loops.prompt: Check if /Users/sovthpaw/Documents/Projects/Projects/topics/talked-architecture/.system/research.md exists and has been updated.
